# template_data_descriptor

A FAIR-style data descriptor exemplar for documenting a dataset's schema,
file inventory, provenance, license, and release checks. It includes
public synthetic CSV fixtures, a Python validation library, and a
renderable descriptor manuscript.

- [Documentation and quick start](docs/README.md)
- [Manuscript and render instructions](docs/manuscript/README.md)
- [Adapting the exemplar](docs/forking.md)
